Monster Party cheat sources and credits

https://gamehacking.org/game/30365
https://gamegenie.com/cheats/gamegenie/nes/monster_party.html

Galoob: starting energy and starting-round codes.
Ugetab: Invincible (AVOEZYSZ), one-hit regular enemies (EYEEIIEL),
and one-hit guardians (AAUEUIZA).
megaman_exe: Endless Bert (SZKEAAVT), walking speed and jump-height codes.

Starting energy: APUPZSGE + AOKPTKGE (boosted), GZUPZSGE + GXKPTKGE (super).
Starting round: PAKOZIAA through YAKOZIAA (rounds 2 through 8).
Walking speed: VNKETXNN + ZEUEAZPA (2x), KNKETXNN + GEUEAZPA (4x).
High jump: APSAIIGA + APSATIGA + AASAYIGE.
Extra high jump: AZSAIIGA + APSATIGA + AASAYIGE.

The recompiled integration uses bank-qualified read substitutions and native
hooks that preserve the game's own hit/defeat paths. It does not apply opcode
patches to compiled instructions. Endless Bert freezes its transformation timer
after a pill is collected. No ROM bytes or game ROM are distributed here.
